Refactored the codebase with two structural cleanup passes:

- Moved the shared queue contract into its own file, [`QueueView.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/QueueView.java#L1-L9), instead of nesting it inside the demo helper.
- Updated [`CircularQueue.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/CircularQueue.java#L8-L198) and [`circular_queue.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/circular_queue.java#L1-L72) to implement the standalone `QueueView<T>`.
- Centralized queue mutation bookkeeping in [`CircularQueue.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/CircularQueue.java#L147-L155) with `recordModification()` and `removeHeadAndRecordModification()`.
- Replaced the anonymous iterator with a named private inner iterator class in [`CircularQueue.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/CircularQueue.java#L171-L197), which makes the fail-fast behavior easier to follow.
- Kept the demo orchestration in [`QueueExamples.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/QueueExamples.java#L1-L16) and the compatibility wrapper in [`circular_queue.java`](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/043_circular_queue/circular_queue.java#L1-L72).
